<a id="page-state"></a>
# State and formulas

Variables, formula variables and functions, bindings, and every formula function. Open it when a value must be
worked out, kept, or shared, or you need a function's signature.

<a id="state-variables"></a>
## Variables

`state name=value` declares a variable of the screen, its type from its value; `state name:type=value` names the
type (`state price:decimal=0`; with no value, `state note:text`). Types: `integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice`. `saved` keeps the
value on the device.

A formula variable is worked out and kept up to date: `state total:decimal={price * qty}`. With parameters it is a
function the formulas call: `state usd(n):text={'$' + round(n)}`.

```notation
state price=2.5
state qty=2
state total:decimal={price * qty}
state usd(n):text={'$' + round(n)}
Text "{usd(total)}"
```

<a id="state-bindings"></a>
## Bindings

`key={expression}` binds any key: `visible={count > 0}`, `fill={done ? '#FF16A34A' : '#FFE5E7EB'}`,
`w={progress * 200}`. `{name}` reads a value as it is; anything else is a formula. A string with values in it is
`"… {x} …"`.

```notation
state count=0
Column gap=8
  Text "Clicked {count} times"
  Text "Twice: {count * 2}"
  Button "Reset" visible={count > 0} onTap={count=0}
```

<a id="state-changing-state"></a>
## Changing state

`name=value` in an event sets a variable (the value a formula). Lists change by setting a new list:

```notation
state cart=[]
Button "Add" onTap={cart=append(cart,"Tea")}
```

`setVariable` and `setValue` with their fields say the rest (an `op` such as `add`, `toggle`, `remove`; an index):
[events.md](events.md#action-setVariable).

| <a id="fn-diffDays"></a>`diffDays` | `diffDays(from, to)` | `diffDays(today(), dueDate) → 5` |
| <a id="fn-timeAgo"></a>`timeAgo` | `timeAgo(date, style?, locale?, labels?)` | `timeAgo(sentAt) → now · 5m · 3h · Yesterday · 3d · Mar 4 · timeAgo(sentAt, "long") → 5 minutes ago (alias formatRelative)` |
| <a id="fn-formatRelative"></a>`formatRelative` | `formatRelative(date, style?, locale?, labels?)` | `formatRelative(sentAt) → 3h (the same as timeAgo)` |
| <a id="fn-isToday"></a>`isToday` | `isToday(date)` | `isToday(sentAt) → true` |
| <a id="fn-isPast"></a>`isPast` | `isPast(date)` | `isPast(expiresAt) → true once it has passed (checked every minute)` |
| <a id="fn-isFuture"></a>`isFuture` | `isFuture(date)` | `isFuture(startsAt) → true until it comes (checked every minute)` |
| <a id="fn-isSameDay"></a>`isSameDay` | `isSameDay(a, b)` | `isSameDay(a.sentAt, b.sentAt) → false` |
| <a id="fn-isBefore"></a>`isBefore` | `isBefore(a, b)` | `isBefore(expiresAt, now()) → true` |
| <a id="fn-isAfter"></a>`isAfter` | `isAfter(a, b)` | `isAfter(startsAt, now()) → false` |
| <a id="fn-year"></a>`year` | `year(date)` | `year("2026-10-21") → 2026` |
| <a id="fn-month"></a>`month` | `month(date)` | `month("2026-10-21") → 10` |
| <a id="fn-day"></a>`day` | `day(date)` | `day("2026-10-21") → 21` |
| <a id="fn-hour"></a>`hour` | `hour(date)` | `hour("2026-10-21T14:30") → 14` |
| <a id="fn-minute"></a>`minute` | `minute(date)` | `minute("2026-10-21T14:30") → 30` |
| <a id="fn-second"></a>`second` | `second(date)` | `second("2026-10-21T14:30:15") → 15` |
| <a id="fn-weekday"></a>`weekday` | `weekday(date)` | `weekday("2026-10-21") → 3 (Monday is 1)` |
| <a id="fn-daysInMonth"></a>`daysInMonth` | `daysInMonth(date)` | `daysInMonth("2026-02-10") → 28` |

<a id="state-colors"></a>
### Colors

| Function | Signature | Example |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fn-luminance"></a>`luminance` | `luminance(color)` | `luminance("#FFFFFF") → 1` |
| <a id="fn-mix"></a>`mix` | `mix(color1, color2, amount)` | `mix('#FFFFFF', '#000000', 0.25) → #BFBFBF` |
| `mix` | `mix(colorA, colorB, t)` | `mix('#000000', '#FFFFFF', 0.5) → #FF808080` |
| <a id="fn-alpha"></a>`alpha` | `alpha(color, opacity)` | `alpha('#FF4D4F', 0.12) → #1FFF4D4F` |
| <a id="fn-lerpColor"></a>`lerpColor` | `lerpColor(colorA, colorB, t), same as mix` | `lerpColor('#FF4D4F', '#1677FF', 0.25) → #FFC5587B` |

<a id="state-logic"></a>
### Logic

| Function | Signature | Example |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fn-if"></a>`if` | `if(condition, then, else)` | `if(qty > 1, "items", "item")` |
| <a id="fn-coalesce"></a>`coalesce` | `coalesce(value, fallback, ...)` | `coalesce(route.date, today())` |

<a id="state-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onValueChanged`](events.md#trigger-valueChanged), [`onActionError`](events.md#trigger-actionError).
- Actions: [`setVariable`](events.md#action-setVariable), [`setValue`](events.md#action-setValue), [`setVariant`](events.md#action-setVariant), [`callFunction`](events.md#action-callFunction), [`if`](events.md#action-if), [`forEach`](events.md#action-forEach), [`delay`](events.md#action-delay), [`runScript`](events.md#action-runScript), [`retryFailed`](events.md#action-retryFailed).

<a id="state-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="state-example-counter-json"></a>
### counter.json

From [`counter.json`](../state.md).

```notation
state count=0
state price=2.5
canvas h=400
Column#col gap=12 middle pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":400} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Text#label "Clicked {count} times" size=18 w={"hug":120} h={"hug":24}
  Text#total "" size=14 color=#FF6B7280 w={"hug":120} h={"hug":20} text={'Total: ' + money(count * price, '$')}
  box#add w=160 h=44 fill=#FF2563EB radius=8 onTap={setVariable variable=count op=add value="1"}
```

<a id="state-example-conditions-json"></a>
### conditions.json

From [`conditions.json`](../state.md).

```notation
state annual=false
canvas h=300
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":300}
  Row#toggle pad=[14,8,14,8] w={"hug":120} h={"hug":36} border=#FF2563EB radius=18 crossAxisAlignment=null onTap={setVariable variable=annual op=toggle}
    Text#toggleLabel "Monthly" size=14 color=#FF2563EB w={"hug":80} h={"hug":20} text={annual ? 'Annual billing' : 'Monthly billing'}
  Text.heading2#price "$12 / month" size=32 w={"hug":80} h={"hug":40}
  Text#note "Save 20% with annual billing" size=14 color=#FF16A34A w={"hug":80} h={"hug":20}
document {"conditions":{"plans":[{"id":"billing","branches":[{"when":{"left":"${annual}","op":"isTrue"},"set":[{"node":"price","path":"props.text","value":"$120 / year"},{"node":"note","path":"visible","value":false}]},{"set":[{"node":"price","path":"props.text","value":"$12 / month"}]}]}]}}
```

<a id="state-example-state-md-variables"></a>
### state.md: variables

From [state.md](../state.md) (the block at line 92 of its template, pages/state.md); its document keys around an empty column.

```notation
state query=""
state dishes=[{"name":"Lamb","vegan":false},{"name":"Squash","vegan":true}]
state shown:list={filter(dishes, d => contains(lower(d.name), lower(query)))}
state shownCount:integer={length(shown)}
state usd(n):text={'$' + round(n)}
Column#body
```

<a id="state-example-state-md-variables-2"></a>
### state.md: variables (2)

From [state.md](../state.md) (the block at line 112 of its template, pages/state.md); its document keys around an empty column.

```notation
state todayIdx:integer={weekday(today()) - 1}
state gapAt(days, end):integer={findIndex(reverse(take(days, end + 1)), d => !d)}
state streak(days, end):integer={gapAt(days, end) < 0 ? end + 1 : gapAt(days, end)}
Column#body
```

<a id="state-example-state-md-if"></a>
### state.md: if

From [state.md](../state.md) (the block at line 132 of its template, pages/state.md); the action on a button's tap.

```notation
Button#run "Run" onTap={contains(saved, trip.id) ? setVariable variable=saved op=remove value={trip.id} : setVariable variable=saved op=add value={trip.id}}
```

<a id="state-example-state-md-setvariable"></a>
### state.md: setVariable

From [state.md](../state.md) (the block at line 142 of its template, pages/state.md); the action on a button's tap.

```notation
Button#run "Run" onTap={setVariable variable=cart op=update index={index} value={set(item, 'qty', item.qty + 1)}}
```
